name: constant
body:
Set src = ThisWorkbook
Set dst = Workbooks.Add
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
src.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 7
src.Names.Add "Amount", "=7"
src.Worksheets(1).Range("B1").Formula = "=Amount+1"
src.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:B1").Copy dst.Worksheets(1).Range("C3")
Report = dst.Worksheets(1).Range("D3").Formula & "|" & CStr(dst.Worksheets(1).Range("D3").Value) & "|"
For Each nm In dst.Names
Report = Report & nm.Name & "=" & nm.RefersTo & "|"
Next nm
